name: level1-lose-bankruptcy
description: Level 1 losing scenario: buy the whole fleet and a full crew, earn nothing, go bankrupt on running costs. The level is funded to exactly the shopping list ($147,500 on `campaign start`) so every purchase is a click a real player could make -- the scenario no longer reaches its loss by overdrawing on a purchase the UI would have refused. It reaches it the way the game intends: BANKRUPTCY_THRESHOLD is $5,000 (balance.ts), the spree ends on $0, and BANKRUPTCY_GRACE_TICKS = 100 ticks of payroll and upkeep with zero income finish the job at tick 100.

steps.description: cash:147500 sits on `campaign start` because that is the step that decides the level's cash: createGameForLevel builds a brand-new GameState from dusty_hollow's own $50,000, so a bump on a `new_game` before it would be discarded. The figure is deliberately exact -- $140,000 of vehicles (rock_digger $50,000 + debris_hauler $25,000 + drill_rig $35,000 + building_destroyer $30,000) plus $7,500 of hires ($1,000 + $1,000 + $1,500 + $800 + $1,200 + $2,000) -- so the shopping spree this scenario is about completes on enabled buttons and lands the player on exactly $0. Not a penny of slack: BANKRUPTCY_THRESHOLD is $5,000 (balance.ts), so the player is under it from the first tick and payroll, not an overdraw the UI would have refused, is what finishes them.

The console now refuses an unaffordable purchase and the level is funded for the full fleet, so this is a real click on the debris_hauler tier-1 row ($25,000) in the panel already open from the rock_digger buy. awaitUsable is the affordability assertion.

expect.note: confirmed via direct trace: `[tick 100] BANKRUPTCY! The mine is seized.` Cash sat under the $5,000 BANKRUPTCY_THRESHOLD from the first tick -- the spree ends on exactly $0 -- so the 100-tick grace window (BANKRUPTCY_GRACE_TICKS) expires at tick 100 and this `tick 15` step is the one that crosses it. Funding the level for its purchases did not save it and did not move the bankruptcy tick: it is payroll and upkeep against no income that does the killing, which is a truer test than an overdraw no player could perform.
